:topic/knowledge-points.:knowledge-point/title: Calculating the Dot Product Using the General Formula

:knowledge-point/canonical-example.:question/problem: Let $[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ and $[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 5 \\ t\end{aligned}]$. Given that $\mathbf{a} \perp \mathbf{b}$, find the value of $t$.
:knowledge-point/canonical-example.:question/worked-solution:
We know that $\mathbf{a} \perp \mathbf{b}$ ($\mathbf{a}$ and $\mathbf{b}$ are perpendicular) if and only if $\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} = 0.$

Computing the dot product, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot b & ={a}_{x}\cdot {b}_{x}+{a}_{y}\cdot {b}_{y}+{a}_{z}\cdot {b}_{z} \\  & =4\cdot (-2)+(-2)\cdot 5+1\cdot t \\  & =-8-10+t \\  & =t-18.\end{aligned}
$$

Setting the dot product equal to $0,$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot b & =0 \\ t-18 & =0 \\ t & =18\end{aligned}
$$
